title: Afternoon Oct 30: book stays defensive; shorts keep running
journal: Book ~$541 (0.99x), regime defensive since the $6.3B Binance hack. Cash ~80% in USDC; two hedges open: the radar's SOL short (entry $94.84, SOL ~$95, flat, stop at +3.5%) and the 55/20 breakout ETH short. SOL is −7% and BTC −5% on the day, and Bitcoin is heading for its worst October in 12 years, so no new memecoins in the book. Fix today: the model that judges the short's live thesis was running out of tokens and falling back to keywords; it now answers again (code fix + radar restart). Devil's advocate: Binance says it will cover all losses, so a relief bounce can hit the short; that is why its stop is tight and it closes within hours if the rebound comes.
